name: Record of Rights (RoR) Extract
shortDescription: View and download digitally signed Record of Rights for agricultural and urban lands across India.

name: Land Holding Statement
shortDescription: Consolidated land holding account details of a landholder across survey parcels in any state.

name: Urban Property Card
shortDescription: City Survey land title card with authenticated ownership, plot boundaries, and area details.

name: Online Mutation Application
shortDescription: Apply for mutation of land records following sale, inheritance, gift, or partition online.

name: Online Rights Application
shortDescription: Apply online for incorporation of rights following registered deed or court decree.

name: Cadastral Survey Request
shortDescription: Apply for Electronic Total Station (ETS) land boundary survey and physical demarcation.

name: Archival Land Records
shortDescription: Search historical land records, old mutation registers, and settlement survey archives.

name: Cadastral Land Map (Bhu-Naksha)
shortDescription: Geo-referenced cadastral map showing plot boundaries, survey/khasra numbers, and village GIS layers.

name: Mutation Status Tracker
shortDescription: Check real-time status of submitted mutation by application number or ULPIN across any state.

name: Property Registration Linkage
shortDescription: Direct verification of registered deeds from Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) linked with land records.

name: Court Case & Dispute Status
shortDescription: Search litigation status in Revenue Quasi-Judicial tribunals and District/High Courts via e-Courts API.

name: Due Diligence 360°
shortDescription: Generate comprehensive composite title, encumbrance, restriction, and zoning dossier for any ULPIN.

name: Grievance Redressal Portal
shortDescription: Lodge complaints regarding delayed mutations, illegal entries, or surveyor issues with district authorities.

name: Certified Copy Issuance
shortDescription: Order certified court-admissible physical copies of revenue maps and RoR extracts online.

name: Land Record Search (ULPIN / Bhu-Aadhaar)
shortDescription: Instant search of any land parcel in India using Unique Land Parcel Identification Number (ULPIN).
